CANDY_AI.DESCRIPTION: Configure CandyAI for AI-assisted customer conversations.

GENERAL.TITLE: General
GENERAL.DESCRIPTION: Control whether CandyAI is available to your account.
GENERAL.ENABLE_HELP: Allow CandyAI to assist with conversations.

PROVIDER.TITLE: AI Provider
PROVIDER.DESCRIPTION: Choose the model provider and model used for CandyAI responses.

HANDOFF.DESCRIPTION: Give customers a clear path to a human agent when AI should stop.
